Presentation of the online sales platform dedicated to organic products

This project is a dynamic and innovative e-commerce platform developed with Laravel, dedicated to the sale of organic and healthy products. It combines a modern and responsive design with seamless navigation to provide customers with a smooth and secure shopping experience.

Users can easily browse, search, and purchase products, while enjoying an engaging and intuitive interface. On the other side, administrators benefit from a powerful dashboard built with Laravel, allowing real-time management of products, categories, inventory, and orders.

This platform is not only a convenient and reliable online store but also a complete Laravel-based solution that promotes healthy living and connects consumers with trusted organic products through a dynamic, user-centered experience.

Employee Management Video Project Overview - Tunisair

This video presents the conceptual design of the management system developed during my internship at Tunisair's headquarters in Tunis as a web development technician. This project aims to centralize and facilitate administrative management within the company through several complementary modules. It includes user management, with a role and permissions system to secure and control access to various functionalities, service and department management to organize the internal structure, and leave request management covering all stages of the process (submission, validation, and history tracking). The system also includes a program and planning management module, providing better organization of activities and resources.

Presentation of the Furniture Sale project

This project consists of developing an e-commerce website for selling furniture and home decoration items. The website will be built using the Laravel (PHP) framework to ensure a robust, secure, and easy-to-maintain solution.

The main objective is to allow customers to browse a wide product catalog, compare items, add their selections to the cart, and place orders online while enjoying a smooth and user-friendly experience.
